meta.storyTitle: VS Code plugin scratchpads: ~/.insrc/scratches store, chat-input scratchpad button with recent/new/browse-all menu, tabular browse webview, Send-to-chat on text selection
meta.triageRationale: Triage classified this as a feature (one cohesive story) reusing the chat webview attach-button/popup/PanelFactory/PATHS.insrc-store patterns; new surface is the ~/.insrc/scratches dir, new protocol message types, and a new scratchpad module + panels. Routed to standalone design.story (LLD) -> plan -> build.

alternativesConsidered.name: Chat-webview menu + dedicated scratchpad webview panels (all-in-plugin, plain files)
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Smallest fully-meeting shape: reuse the chat popup for the menu, new webview viewTypes for browse-all and the scratchpad document with floating Send-to-chat; storage via a new vscode-free scratch-store over ~/.insrc/scratches.
alternativesConsidered.approach: One new vscode-free module `vscode-plugin/src/chat/scratch-store.ts` (ScratchFs + node impl; list/create/read/delete over `~/.insrc/scratches/*.md` named `<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>-<slug>.md`), wired in extension.ts next to the attachment store as `join(PATHS.insrc, 'scratches')`. Chat webview: sibling `.attachbtn`-class icon button `#insrc-scratch` next to `#insrc-attach` opening the existing `.popup`/`.item` menu with recent items (top 5 by mtime), New, and Browse-all rows; new message types in protocol.ts. Browse-all = new webview panel viewType `insrc.scratchpads` and document = `insrc.scratchpad`, both owned by a new vscode-free scratch-panels controller (panels/scratch-panels.ts) wrapping the injected PanelFactory with a per-viewType create-or-reveal singleton cache and a setTitle operation, sharing the CSP+nonce shell extracted to panels/shell.ts; the browse table has name/date/icon-only open-delete rows. Opening a scratchpad = document viewType `insrc.scratchpad` with a floating Send-to-chat button on selection posting `send-to-chat`; host pushes `insert-into-input`; the chat webview inserts the text and focuses the input.
pros: Matches existing patterns exactly (attach button family, histmenu popup, PanelFactory, PATHS.insrc stores, protocol lists) — least new surface, fully testable with fake-dom + fake fs.
No daemon IPC, plain files only — exactly the requested scope.
Icon-only buttons with title tooltips come free from the `.attachbtn`/`.popup .item` CSS family.
cons: One new host→webview input-insertion message is needed (none exists).
The selection-handler script lives in the scratchpad document view, not the chat panel.

alternativesConsidered.name: Native QuickPick + text-document editor with command-based send-to-chat
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Host-side QuickPick menu and a real text editor for scratchpads; selection send-to-chat via command rather than a floating webview button.
alternativesConsidered.approach: VS Code native `window.showQuickPick` for the menu (host-side), `window.createWebviewPanel` for the browse-all table, `vscode.window.showTextDocument` for opening a scratchpad (a real editor), Send-to-chat as a registered command on a status-bar affordance.
pros: QuickPick is native, zero webview code for the menu.
A real text document gives syntax highlighting for free.
cons: Native QuickPick moves the menu out of the in-panel dropdown next to the attach button.
A real text document cannot show a floating button on text selection — the user explicitly wants selection → floating button, which forces a webview document view anyway.
More host-side VS Code API surface, less reuse of the proven in-webview patterns.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Rank 3: a native QuickPick moves the menu out of the requested in-panel location next to attach, and a real text document cannot show the required floating Send-to-chat button on selection — the defining interaction is violated.

alternativesConsidered.name: Sidebar tree view for browse-all + webview reader
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Register a scratchpads TreeDataProvider in a sidebar; chat button opens recent/new; tree provides browse-all and open/delete.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Scratchpads as a sidebar tree view (`TreeDataProvider` over ~/.insrc/scratches); chat button only for new/recent; browse-all = the tree itself; open renders in a webview reader pane.
pros: Native VS Code navigation for the file list.
Delete/open are one-click in the tree.
cons: Adds a sidebar contribution point (package.json views + tree provider) — more surface than asked; the user asked for a button next to attach + a tabular editor pane.
Tree views don't natively offer per-row icon-only open/delete buttons with hover text in the requested tabular layout.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Rank 4: a sidebar TreeDataProvider is not the requested editor-pane tabular view with per-row icon-only open/delete buttons, and adds an unrequested package.json views contribution (L cost).

alternativesConsidered.name: Single-webview overlay for browse + view
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Menu in chat webview; browse-all and scratchpad viewing as overlays within the same chat webview.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Chat-webview popup for the menu, but browse-all and single-scratchpad viewing rendered as overlay panes inside the SAME chat webview (no separate panel), with the Send-to-chat floating button inside that overlay.
cons: Overlays complicate the chat panel's state machine/viewGeneration logic; a separate panel matches the existing PanelFactory.
Selection handling inside the chat transcript collides with the existing selection-decision/edit-mode feature.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Rank 2: an overlay inside the chat webview is not an editor-pane panel, and selection handling there collides with the existing in-chat selection-decision/edit-mode feature.

components.description: New vscode-free, deps-injected store (ScratchFs interface + node impl) managing plain .md files under ~/.insrc/scratches: list/create/read/delete, id validation, temp+rename writes. Mirrors attachment-store.ts.

Webview-to-host and host-to-webview message unions plus the HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES / WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES const arrays (exhaustiveness asserted in protocol.test.ts). Gains the eight scratchpad message types.

Inline-HTML chat webview: gains the #insrc-scratch .attachbtn sibling button next to #insrc-attach, the #insrc-scratchmenu .popup.chatmenu, bootstrap listeners, host-side switch cases, and the insert-into-input handler on #insrc-input (:2784).

Extension activation: constructs createScratchStore with root join(PATHS.insrc, 'scratches') next to the attachment store (~:635), registers the scratch message handlers, and injects the panels factory (:447) used for the two new viewTypes.

NEW vscode-free scratch-panels controller: wraps the injected PanelFactory (extension.ts:447) with its own create-or-reveal singleton cache per viewType (mirroring openSingleton at webview-host.ts:214), exposes setTitle for tab-title updates on the cached insrc.scratchpad document panel, and owns the generation counter. Backs insrc.scratchpads (tabular browse) and insrc.scratchpad (document + floating Send-to-chat).

Shared CSP+nonce shell (shellHtml) extracted from panels/webview-host.ts:635 into panels/shell.ts so the chat panel and both scratch viewTypes share the identical shell; existing CSP/nonce tests keep passing against the extraction.
Shared path constant: PATHS.insrc = join(homedir(), '.insrc'); the scratches root derives from it, never a hard-coded path.

componentDependencyDefinition.narrative: Shows the module boundary of the scratchpad feature: one new vscode-free store module, additive protocol messages, chat-webview DOM/bootstrap, extension wiring, plus the new scratch-panels controller and the extracted shared shell — with zero daemon/DB modules in the dependency set, matching the no-daemon-IPC constraint.

errors.condition: root path is not a directory or mkdir fails (EACCES/ENOSPC)

id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\.md$ AND must not be '.' or '..' AND resolve (via path.resolve) to a path strictly inside the store root AND lstat must report a regular file (symlinks are refused, not followed); any violation -> ScratchRefused before ANY fs call beyond the lstat

api.name: createScratchStore

parameters.name: deps
parameters.purpose: Deps-injected root (+ optional fs/clock/logger); fs is OPTIONAL and defaults to the node adapter (nodeScratchFs) when omitted — the exact optional-fs + node-default pattern of createAttachmentStore (vscode-plugin/src/chat/attachment-store.ts, wired at extension.ts:635), so production wiring can pass only { root, logger } (root = join(PATHS.insrc, 'scratches'), PATHS.insrc = join(homedir(), '.insrc') per src/shared/paths.ts:4-8)
parameters.type: { root: string; fs?: ScratchFs; now?: () => Date; logger?: Logger }

postconditions: Store is ready; the scratches root exists or is created lazily on first write
No daemon IPC is involved — pure filesystem
preconditions: deps.root is an absolute path under ~/.insrc

returns.meaning: Store handle exposing list/create/read/delete; vscode-free so fake-dom/fake-fs tests can drive it

api.name: listScratches

parameters.name: limit?
parameters.purpose: Cap the returned list (the popup menu passes 5 for recents); OMIT for the unbounded full list — browse-all calls listScratches() with no limit so no entry is ever omitted

postconditions: Entries are sorted by mtime descending (most recent first)
Each entry carries id, name, mtime and size; ids are the file basenames

errors.condition: write EACCES/ENOSPC or no free collision name within the ladder

api.name: createScratch

parameters.name: title
parameters.purpose: Human title for the new scratchpad; slugified into the file name

parameters.name: body?
parameters.purpose: Initial content; omitted = a short starter line inviting notes

postconditions: A new file <yyyymmdd-hhmmss>-<slug>.md exists under the root (collision suffixes -2, -3, ... chosen by probing lstat for non-existence)

Publication is exclusive and cross-process safe: the temp file gets a unique name (pid + random suffix, not matching *.md), and the final link(oldpath, newpath) + unlink(temp) pair is atomic no-clobber (Node link() fails with EEXIST when the destination exists — unlike rename, which replaces it); on EEXIST the next suffix (-2, -3, ...) is probed and the pair retried, so a concurrent create in another VS Code window can never replace an existing scratchpad and both complete contents survive; any failure BEFORE the link() is a failed create with no scratchpad created (temp best-effort removed); link() itself is the single atomic publication point — once it succeeds the scratchpad EXISTS and the create is a success, so a subsequent unlink(temp) failure is non-fatal: the orphaned temp name does not match *.md, is invisible to listScratches, and is best-effort cleaned on the next create; the documented failure is never returned after publication, and a retry in that window cannot double-create because the EEXIST suffix ladder covers it

Content is written to the temp file first (never a partial .md visible); publication is the link(oldpath, newpath) + unlink(temp) pair ONLY — rename is never used anywhere in the store, because rename would replace a destination created after the existence probe; link() is the sole atomic no-clobber publication primitive (EEXIST -> next suffix)
The new entry appears at the head of listScratches unless an existing entry has a strictly later mtime (e.g. a future-dated file) or an equal-mtime tie resolved by id ascending
api.signature: function createScratch(title: string, body?: string): Promise<ScratchEntry>

errors.condition: id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\.md$ AND must not be '.' or '..' AND resolve (via path.resolve) to a path strictly inside the store root AND the file is opened with open(path, O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW) and fstat on that fd must report a regular file — a no-follow open, so a symlink swapped in after any earlier check still yields ELOOP -> ScratchRefused and is never followed; any violation -> ScratchRefused before ANY read beyond that open/fstat

the no-follow open rejects ENOENT (file missing before open) OR a read on that fd rejects ENOENT (file deleted between open and read) — both map to ScratchNotFound; the single fd is the source of truth, so validation and read cannot observe different files

api.name: readScratch

parameters.name: id
parameters.purpose: File basename of the scratchpad to open in the document view

postconditions: The full markdown content is returned for rendering
Content is rendered via textContent/escapeHtml only — CSP invariant kept

The document panel tracks a monotonically increasing openGeneration per scratch-open request; when the async read resolves, the host applies it only if its generation matches the panel’s current generation (a stale read is dropped). Title/content/selection state are replaced atomically; deleting id X closes the panel only if it currently displays X AND invalidates every still-pending open of X: each scratch-open captures its openGeneration at click time and deleteScratch bumps that scratchpad's epoch, so an in-flight readScratch(X) that resolves late finds a generation mismatch and its render is dropped — not merely a panel-close guard; a stale ScratchNotFound for another id is ignored; disposing the panel invalidates its generation check
preconditions: Store created; id passes the filename validation (see errors) before any fs call

returns.meaning: Full text content plus entry metadata

api.signature: function readScratch(id: string): Promise<{ entry: ScratchEntry; content: string }>

errors.condition: id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\.md$ AND must not be '.' or '..' AND resolve (via path.resolve) to a path strictly inside the store root AND lstat must report a regular file (symlinks are refused, not followed); any violation -> ScratchRefused before ANY fs call beyond the lstat
lstat reports ENOENT (already deleted before validation) OR unlink rejects with ENOENT (deleted between lstat and unlink)
errors.type: treated as success (delete is idempotent: missing file at any checkpoint resolves successfully and refreshes the table / closes the panel only if it displays that id)

api.name: deleteScratch

parameters.name: id
parameters.purpose: File basename to delete from the browse table row or the document view

postconditions: The file is gone (or was already gone) and drops out of listScratches
Deleting the currently open document closes that panel
preconditions: Store created; id passes the filename validation (see errors) before any fs call; delete uses lstat-confirmed regular files only and unlink (never recursive rm), so a symlink or directory named *.md can never be removed

errors.condition: unknown payload.type in the host switch
errors.type: ignored (never throws — postMessage failures are swallowed per extension.ts:465-468 pattern)

errors.condition: title prompt cancelled or empty after trim -> no createScratch call; menu re-renders with the unchanged list

api.name: chat host message handlers (switch on payload.type, chat-panel.ts:3566 pattern)

parameters.name: msg
parameters.purpose: Webview→host messages 'scratch-open-menu' | 'scratch-new' (TITLELESS intent — the host acquires the title itself) | 'scratch-open' {id} | 'scratch-delete' {id} | 'scratch-browse' | 'send-to-chat' {text}; host→webview 'scratch-list' {entries} | 'insert-into-input' {text} — each added to its OWN direction's union and const list (WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES :403 / HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES :378), exhaustiveness + direction isolation asserted in protocol.test.ts

postconditions: 'scratch-open-menu' replies with 'scratch-list' of the top 5

'scratch-new' (titleless) → host prompts for a title via the injected prompt-for-title boundary (window.showInputBox, extension.ts:606, fake in tests), then createScratch(title), replies 'scratch-list', opens the document view
'scratch-open' opens/creates-or-reveals the insrc.scratchpad document panel
'scratch-delete' deletes then refreshes any open browse table
'scratch-browse' opens/creates-or-reveals the insrc.scratchpads table panel

'send-to-chat' first REVEALS the chat panel (panel.reveal() — the chat does not retain its page while hidden and its readiness handshake discards covered tabs, so a hidden chat cannot reliably receive the insertion), waits for the chat webview's ready handshake before posting, then pushes 'insert-into-input' {text} to the chat webview; if the chat panel was disposed meanwhile the message is dropped silently (same swallow pattern); text must be a string; it is truncated multibyte-safe so the final string INCLUDING the trailing '…' stays within 65,536 UTF-8 bytes

title handoff is concrete: the webview sends titleless 'scratch-new'; ONLY the host asks the user (injected showInputBox boundary); cancel/empty-after-trim = no createScratch call and the menu re-renders with the unchanged list. The title is validated at runtime too (must be a string) alongside ids/texts
on any store failure the host replies 'scratch-list' { entries: [], error: '<reason>' } — an explicit optional error field (attachments-pending pattern), distinct from a successful empty list
preconditions: Chat panel is alive; scratch store is wired in extension.ts next to :635

returns.meaning: Side effects on panels + webviews; no return value

errors.type: undefined returned + logged via panelLog (never throws; the handler degrades to a VS Code notification)

api.name: scratch webview panels via the injected PanelFactory (extension.ts:447)

parameters.name: viewType
parameters.purpose: 'insrc.scratchpads' | 'insrc.scratchpad' — insrc.scratchpads = browse-all tabular editor-pane view (columns Name, Modified; per-row icon-only Open/Delete buttons with title hover text + data-id); insrc.scratchpad = singleton single-document view with a selectionchange listener

parameters.name: title
parameters.purpose: Panel title at creation (scratchpad name for the document view); the handle ALSO exposes setTitle(title) so a cached singleton can replace the editor tab title

postconditions: Browse table rows post scratch-open {id} / scratch-delete {id}; the document view posts send-to-chat {text} from its floating button on non-empty selection

Both viewTypes are single-instance create-or-reveal; onDidDispose clears the cached handle so the next open creates fresh. Switching the insrc.scratchpad singleton from A to B calls setTitle(B) + setHtml on the SAME cached panel, so the editor tab title updates together with content and selection state
preconditions: Panels factory injected at extension.ts:447; the shared CSP+nonce shell (shellHtml, webview-host.ts:635) is extracted to panels/shell.ts (or re-exported) so the scratch panels get the identical shell

returns.meaning: A live PanelHandle (setHtml/reveal/setTitle/onDidDispose/onMessage/postMessage/dispose) — setTitle is an injected title-update operation with a production adapter calling the underlying WebviewPanel title setter (the stock PanelHandle at panels/types.ts:134-135 has none). A new vscode-free scratch-panels controller wraps the factory with its own create-or-reveal singleton cache per viewType (mirroring the private openSingleton in panels/webview-host.ts:214); undefined + panelLog warning on creation failure

api.signature: panels({ viewType: ScratchViewType, title: string }): PanelHandle | undefined

api.name: floating Send-to-chat button (document view bootstrap)

parameters.name: sel
parameters.purpose: window.getSelection() on selectionchange inside the insrc.scratchpad document view; button is icon-only with title="Send to chat"

postconditions: A floating icon-only button (title="Send to chat") appears near the selection and posts { type: 'send-to-chat', text } with the captured selection text (captured at selectionchange, before the click, so focus/selectionchange cannot lose it)

Host pushes 'insert-into-input' to the chat webview, which applies ONE deterministic insertion rule to the editable textarea #insrc-input (chat-panel.ts:2784; #insrc-prompt at :2783 is the send/stop span and is NEVER an insertion target): the text is spliced in at the caret position, REPLACING any active selection range; if the caret is at the very end of the value (or selection info is unavailable) it appends with a single separating newline when the current value is non-empty; all other existing content is preserved; then focuses #insrc-input; the turn is NEVER auto-sent
preconditions: Document view is open and has focus

dataModelChanges.details: ScratchEntry { id, name, mtime, size } — metadata for one ~/.insrc/scratches/<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>-<slug>.md file. id = file basename; validated as a *.md filename that is not '.'/'..' and resolves strictly inside the store root, with lstat confirming a regular file (symlinks refused), before any fs call. Stored as plain markdown files; no daemon store, no LMDB/Lance row. Entries are enumerated by readdir + lstat (ENOENT → []), symlinks and non-files skipped, sorted by mtime desc (size in bytes, mtime in ms since epoch, ties broken by id ascending for deterministic order), optionally limited (menu top 5). Name-after-restart policy: the file basename retains only the slug, not the original title, so after a restart ScratchEntry.name is reconstructed from the id (the <yyyymmdd-hhmmss>-<slug> basename) — the original showInputBox title is not persisted.

Eight new message types added to the webview→host and host→webview unions, each to its OWN direction's const array only: webview→host 'scratch-open-menu', 'scratch-new' (titleless intent; the host acquires the title via the injected showInputBox boundary), 'scratch-open' {id}, 'scratch-delete' {id}, 'scratch-browse', 'send-to-chat' {text} go in WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES (protocol.ts:403); host→webview 'scratch-list' {entries, error?}, 'insert-into-input' {text} go in HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES (:378). Payload field names are part of the contract; ids/texts/titles must be strings at runtime (non-string payloads are rejected by the host switch). protocol.test.ts gains direction-isolation assertions: each new type appears in its own array and NOT in the other's, and the unions cover the arrays exactly.

Chat webview DOM additions: a sibling icon-only button #insrc-scratch (class attachbtn, inline SVG, title="scratchpads") directly next to #insrc-attach (:2796); a dropdown #insrc-scratchmenu reusing the .popup.chatmenu / .item pattern of #insrc-histmenu (:2766, opens upward :2289, rows :2296) whose items are recent entries + "New scratchpad" + "Browse all"; one bootstrap listener (:2465-2486 pattern) posting 'scratch-open-menu'; the host 'insert-into-input' handler inserts text into #insrc-input (:2784) and focuses it — #insrc-prompt (:2783) is the send/stop span and is NEVER an insertion target. Attach flow (.attachbar :2787, 'pick-attachments' :3566) untouched.
dataModelChanges.entity: Chat status-bar UI: scratchpad button + popup menu + input insertion

dataModelChanges.details: Two new webview viewTypes through the existing injected PanelFactory: 'insrc.scratchpads' (browse-all tabular editor-pane view: columns Name and Modified, per-row icon-only Open/Delete buttons with title hover text and data-id) and 'insrc.scratchpad' (single-document view rendering scratch content via textContent only, with the selectionchange → floating icon-only "Send to chat" button). Both keep the shared CSP+nonce shell (extracted to panels/shell.ts) and create-or-reveal single-instance lifecycle owned by a NEW vscode-free scratch-panels controller (panels/scratch-panels.ts) wrapping the injected PanelFactory; the controller exposes setTitle on its handle, and the singleton document view calls setTitle + setHtml on the same panel when switching scratchpads. The insrc.scratchpad document view is a SINGLETON panel with a generation counter: opening B while A is displayed bumps the generation, replaces title+content+selection state on render, and discards a late-resolving read of A; ScratchNotFound closes the panel only when the failing id is the one currently displayed.

edgeCases.expected: listScratches returns [] — the menu shows only "New scratchpad" + "Browse all", and Browse all shows an empty table with a hint row
edgeCases.input: No ~/.insrc/scratches directory exists yet (fresh install) — readdir ENOENT

edgeCases.expected: File name gets a -2 (then -3, ...) suffix and the entry is created without error
edgeCases.input: Two scratchpads created within the same second from the same title (yyyymmdd-hhmmss-slug collision)

edgeCases.expected: createScratch slugifies the title (lowercase, spaces to dashes, non [a-z0-9-] dropped) so the generated id always matches ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$; an all-symbol title falls back to 'scratch'
edgeCases.input: Title containing unicode, spaces, slashes or other non-slug characters

edgeCases.expected: The entry is skipped from the list (not a crash); an entry whose stat fails is dropped rather than failing the whole list
edgeCases.input: A file in ~/.insrc/scratches disappears between readdir and stat

edgeCases.expected: Non-.md files in the scratches dir are ignored by listScratches; the temp file from an interrupted write is ignored (its name does not end in .md)
edgeCases.input: Directory contains unrelated files (e.g. .DS_Store, a leftover .tmp)

edgeCases.expected: send-to-chat is accepted up to 64 KiB; larger selections are truncated so the FINAL inserted string including the trailing ellipsis stays within 65,536 UTF-8 bytes, and still inserted
edgeCases.input: User selects more than 64 KiB of text in the scratchpad document view

edgeCases.expected: readScratch/deleteScratch refuse before touching the filesystem (ScratchRefused); the host handler logs and ignores the message
edgeCases.input: A webview-to-host scratch-open/scratch-delete payload carries an id with path separators or shell metacharacters (../, ;, spaces)

edgeCases.expected: Deleting an already-deleted id resolves successfully — ENOENT at lstat or at unlink is success (idempotent delete); the browse table just re-renders without the row
edgeCases.input: User double-clicks Delete on the same browse-table row

edgeCases.expected: A subsequent store operation (list/read/delete) detects the external deletion at its own lstat and resolves ScratchNotFound (the panel closes only if it displays that id) or drops the row from the browse table; no watcher closes the panel live, and selecting/sending already-rendered text does NOT re-read the file — the guarantee is narrowed to the next store operation
edgeCases.input: The scratchpad file backing an open insrc.scratchpad document view is deleted (from the browse table or the filesystem)

edgeCases.expected: insert-into-input splices the text at the caret of #insrc-input — replacing an active range selection; appending with one separating newline only when the caret is at the end and the draft is non-empty — and focuses #insrc-input; the turn is NOT sent
edgeCases.input: Chat input #insrc-input already contains unsent text (caret mid-draft or an active selection range) when insert-into-input arrives

edgeCases.expected: The floating button stays hidden; nothing is posted
edgeCases.input: User clicks into the document without selecting any text (collapsed selection) and selectionchange fires

errorCases.detection: fs.mkdir/readdir/writeFile rejects with code EACCES, ENOSPC, EROFS, or the root is not a directory
errorCases.response: createScratchStore/list/create surface ScratchStoreError; the host handler catches, logs via panelLog and replies 'scratch-list' { entries: [], error: 'scratchpads unavailable: <reason>' } — a typed error distinct from a successful empty list (optional error field, attachments-pending pattern); the menu renders the error row and still offers Browse all, which shows an error row; a later successful scratch-open-menu re-renders the real list (recovery by retry)
errorCases.scenario: ~/.insrc/scratches cannot be created or written (read-only home, disk full, permissions)
errorCases.userImpact: Scratchpads cannot be listed/created; the attach flow and chat itself keep working (failure is contained to the scratch features)

errorCases.detection: id fails the ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ check before any fs call
errorCases.response: readScratch/deleteScratch throw ScratchRefused; host logs and ignores the message — no filesystem access happens
errorCases.scenario: Malicious or malformed id in a webview message (path traversal ../, separators, metacharacters)
errorCases.userImpact: No impact; the attempt is refused and logged

errorCases.detection: lstat or readFile on the id rejects with ENOENT
errorCases.response: readScratch maps ENOENT (at lstat or readFile) to ScratchNotFound; deleteScratch maps ENOENT (at lstat or unlink) to success; the host closes the document panel ONLY if it currently displays that id, and refreshes the browse table so the stale row disappears. There is no file watcher: an already-rendered document stays open until the next interaction (narrowed guarantee — external deletion is detected on read, not observed live)
errorCases.scenario: Opening or deleting a scratchpad whose file was deleted out-of-band while the menu/table was showing
errorCases.userImpact: Stale menu/table row resolves on next interaction; no crash

errorCases.detection: writeFile of the temp file or the rename fails mid-create
errorCases.response: ScratchStoreError surfaces to the host; the temp file is best-effort removed; no partial .md file is left visible (temp name does not match the *.md listing filter)
errorCases.scenario: Crash or EACCES/ENOSPC between temp write and rename during createScratch
errorCases.userImpact: No scratchpad is created; user can retry from the menu

errorCases.detection: readdir succeeds but a stat on an entry rejects, or an entry is a directory named *.md

summary.prose: This story adds scratchpads to the VS Code chat: a scratchpad icon button next to the attach button opens a menu with recent scratchpads, a New scratchpad item and a Browse all item. Browse all opens a tabular editor pane (name, date, icon-only open/delete) over the scratchpads stored as plain markdown files in ~/.insrc/scratches. Opening a scratchpad shows its content in an editor pane where selecting text reveals a floating "Send to chat" button that drops the selection into the chat input (never auto-sends). No daemon IPC is added. Acceptance criteria: ac1 = scratchpads are stored as plain .md files under ~/.insrc/scratches via the vscode-free store (list/create/read/delete); ac2 = an icon-only scratchpad button next to the attach button opens a popup with the 5 most recent entries + New scratchpad + Browse all; ac3 = Browse all opens a single-instance tabular editor pane (Name, Modified, icon-only Open/Delete per row); ac4 = opening a scratchpad shows a document pane where selecting text reveals a floating icon-only Send-to-chat button that inserts the selection into #insrc-input and focuses it (never auto-sends); ac5 = every new button is icon-only with a title hover text. Editing existing scratchpad content inside the plugin is OUT OF SCOPE for this increment (the document view is read-only; content is created via New and edited as a plain file outside the plugin; re-opening a scratchpad re-reads the file, so externally edited content is picked up on the next open). Round-3 review corrections: link()-only publication with post-link unlink-failure semantics defined; O_NOFOLLOW fd-based reads; send-to-chat reveals the chat and awaits its ready handshake; the popup menu itself is now depicted in the UX mock; delete invalidates pending opens of the deleted id; browse-all fetches an unbounded list.

uxDefinition.narrative: The story introduces three user-facing surfaces — the chat status-bar button + popup menu, the tabular Browse-all editor pane, and the scratchpad document pane with its floating Send-to-chat button on text selection — and pins that every button is icon-only with hover text (title). The chat layout matches the live two-row structure (input bar with send + textarea; separate status bar with attach + scratchpad). Separate cards show the browse pane populated, empty and error states, and the document pane with a highlighted selection and the floating button anchored at it. Empty and error states of the menu are shown as well.
